If any fellow actors fancy teaming up to film some two-person scenes for our reels, I’d love to hear from you. I can handle all the filming, sound and editing—just drop me a message if you’re interested!

FILM HISTORYCZNY 13.10 lub 14.10

Film historyczny na podstawie kultowej powieści. Akcja rozgrywa się na przełomie XIX i XX wieku.
Szukamy Panów i chłopców z Warszawy i okolic.

PRZYMIARKI
12.10 – Warszawa, ul. Marynarska 14

Stawka 170zl dorośli
dzieci 250
(plan + przymiarki)

Prosimy o zgłaszanie się osób:
- bez współczesnych fryzur,
- bez wygolonych boków i strzyżenia maszynką,
- bez aparatów ortodontycznych

Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać na:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

Tytuł maila: 13.10 lub 14.10

W treści prosimy podać:

- aktualne, wykonane w dniu zgłoszenia zdjęcia: selfie twarzy, zdjęcie fryzury z boku oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki,
- imię i nazwisko,
- wiek,
- wzrost,
- informację czy jest aparat na zębach 
- numer telefonu.

❗ Zdjęcia muszą być aktualne. Zgłoszenia ze starymi zdjęciami lub zdjęciami, na których wyglądacie inaczej niż obecnie, nie będą brane pod uwagę.

Zapraszam do zgłoszeń

items.text: How much should babies make for a background role but will be the main character baby

topComments.text: It’s usually sa rate babies get paid

My son played the lead baby double on a tv show once. We were booked for general bg then the lead baby freaked out and my son was pulled in as her stand in. Yes, he played a girl. Joy to babies who can look both ways lol

But it all depends on how they hired the baby in the first place. The baby on the show was hired in as core BG, I believe, so my son was still paid as BG. 

In our experience, and we have not really done background for the last 4/5 years, kids bg are usually hired on SAG vouchers (but do not have to count for membership).

Background is still paid as BG unless you were specifically bumped, then its a whole contract thing. If its a studio project, it will be prevailing SAG BG rate for the day. If its not studio, or outside of CA, or not SAG… well, thats the wild wild west and no one can answer that for you.

📢 **CASTING CALL: NEW MUSICAL** 📢

Clapping Productions are looking for talented performers excited to originate a character and help bring a brand-new musical to the stage.

 

**LITTLE WHITE FEATHERS** is an exciting new musical about love, loss, family-ties, and the belief that our deceased loved ones may still be with us. With 17 original songs, this brand-new musical is filled with mystery, humour, heart, and hope.

 

💰 **THIS IS A PROFIT-SHARE PRODUCTION**
📍 **VENUE:** Hope Street Theatre, Liverpool
📅 **PLAYING DATES:** 6th, 7th & 8th May 2027
🎭 **REHEARSALS:** Liverpool
🚗 **EXPENSES PAID:** Petrol and bus fares. Light refreshments supplied throughout rehearsals and performances.

 

**SHOW WILL BE VIDEOED - A SHOWREEL WILL BE GIVEN TO EACH PERFORMER**

👥 **ROLES AVAILABLE:**

 
* **MAGGIE MAGUIRE** — Female, 55 (Irish | Feisty | Salt of the earth | Highly emotional)
A warm-hearted, passionate, and determined Irish woman who wears her heart on her sleeve.
* **JACK MAGUIRE** — Male, 55 (Scouser | Jovial | Funny | Lovable)
Maggie's devoted husband. A cheeky-chappie with a great sense of humour.
* **PSYCHIC SID** — Male, 40–65 (Dramatic | Flamboyant | Theatrical)
A larger-than-life celebrity psychic and natural showman who knows how to command an audience.
* **EMMY BRIGHT** — Female, 26 (South American | Vivacious | Cute | Confident)
A vibrant, charismatic young woman with energy and personality. Confident and engaging.
* **JUDE TAYLOR** — Male, 28 (Posh | Shy | Geeky)
Intelligent, slightly awkward, and endearingly shy.

📧 **HOW TO APPLY:**
To apply for a role, please send your CV, Showreel, or Self-Tape to:
👉 **[info@clappingproductions.com](mailto:info@clappingproductions.com)**

Mile High Films is looking for a pair of children—one Black and one white, both ages 6–11—for an upcoming shoot.  Friends or classmates are preferred.  Please apply as a pair; we are only considering children who apply together.

• Shoot length: Approximately 1 hour
• Pay: $200 per child
• Location and schedule: Flexible
• Timing: Must film before October 12

A parent or guardian for must be present during filming.

Interested parents or guardians, please send me a private message with both children’s ages, recent photos, your general location, and availability.

Production company: Mile High Films

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Lead roles: $150/day. Minor roles: $50/day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**See attached for Roles and more information.**

**PAID GIG (£75) – Looking for someone to dress up as a deeply unsettling Cat in the Hat for 15 minutes**

Hi everyone! Slightly bizarre request, but I'm looking for an actor, comedian or generally theatrical person for a surprise appearance at my 25th birthday party in London on **Friday 30 October**.

Essentially, I want someone dressed as the Cat in the Hat (ideally the slightly terrifying Mike Myers 2003 movie version) to show up completely unexpectedly at a bar where I'm celebrating with around 30 friends, cause some harmless chaos, and then disappear without explanation.

I'm imagining strange dancing, exaggerated movements, prolonged awkward eye contact, absurd interactions with guests, and generally committing 100% to being a deeply unsettling Cat in the Hat.

**The actual performance will last a MAXIMUM of 15 minutes (ideally around 10).** No lengthy entertainment booking, just a very strange and memorable appearance.

I'll source and provide the costume, so you'd just need to turn up, get into character, and embrace the absurdity!

**Details:**
* Friday 30 October 2026
* Central London (exact venue TBC)
* Approximately 9:30pm
* Maximum 15-minute performance
* £75, negotiable

Experience with acting, improvisation or physical comedy would be great, but most importantly I'm looking for someone who really understands the vision and can commit to the bit.

Please DM me if interested, ideally with any relevant performance experience or videos. Recommendations also very welcome!

topComments.text: Fair enough fee but doesn’t factor in travel time and expenses along with rig and de-rig

Are you are a parent on this group trying to find opportunities for your child? Do they want to do it as a career but you don't know where to start?

Former Child Actor, West End lead and Performing Arts School principal, Megan Jones has just launched Showing Up https://showingup.uk a dedicated course for parents. It's not about selling a dream, it's about preparing parents through 20 years of lived experience. 

Megan wants as many people to watch the safeguarding episode so is currently giving this away for free on the link if you want to find out more https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YHemHyfmTVs

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1639070284676674

sharedPost.text:
I went into the industry aged 10 and my parents and I knew NOTHING.

Every job I got was despite the mistakes we made and the insider knowledge we didn’t have.

It’s a very “if you know you know” world.. and we did not know 😂

Knowledge is power and after 20+ years in the industry as an actor (stage and screen), teacher, principal of my own performing arts school, licensed chaperone and now a mum, I want to give parents the knowledge I wish I’d had growing up.

Introducing SHOWING UP 💕

An online video course for parents of young performers, covering the things you NEED to know when your child starts exploring the world of professional acting and the performing arts.

With episodes on safeguarding, finding an agent, creating self-tapes, headshots, further training and scholarship/ bursary opportunities… I cover the things you might not even know to ask about.

This industry is SO competitive, and I am absolutely not here to sell you the dream. Quite the opposite.

I’m here to help you understand the reality, ask the right questions and make informed decisions for your child.

If you are navigating this world, you no longer have to do it alone.

https://showingup.uk 💕

🎬📽️🎶🎭🩰🎤

TYSM @sammsalter @missnatashamould @ellenkatesheridan @jemmamckenziebrown @lauraemmitt @kristiepearce_ @dancewithmisskristie @elladv_ for these videos.. full length versions to come! 💕

Bei Alphatrail entwickeln wir hochwertige Fahrradhelme und Zubehör. Jetzt setzen wir unsere brandneuen Premiumfahrradhelme in München mit Fotos und Videos in Szene.

10 de octubre | Día Nacional de la Danza en Argentina

Hay quienes dedican su vida a la danza y, aun después de partir, continúan habitando los escenarios a través de su legado.

El 10 de octubre de 1971, nueve bailarines del Ballet Estable del Teatro Colón perdieron la vida en un accidente aéreo mientras viajaban para ofrecer una función benéfica.

Entre ellos se encontraban Norma Fontenla y José Neglia, dos grandes figuras del ballet argentino.

En su memoria, Argentina conmemora cada 10 de octubre el Día Nacional de la Danza.

Hoy, desde cualquier rincón del mundo donde la danza encuentre un cuerpo para expresarse, podemos honrar su memoria y reconocer a quienes hicieron del movimiento su vocación y del escenario una forma de trascender.

Porque hay vidas que terminan, pero su danza permanece.

Greetings Actors! Seeking an African American male actor who has singing talent and is comfortable playing a gay role as Franklin. We also have an open role as Stanley, and details for each character are below for our upcoming stage production, which is coming on December 12th and 19th, performing live in both Macon & Atlanta, GA. These are paid roles. Please do not submit if you are not reliable or unable to attend scheduled rehearsals. These are every Tuesday and Thursday via Zoom, 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, and in person every 1st and 3rd Saturdays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Accepting castings from local Atlanta actors or surrounding cities. Auditions are held via Zoom. Please submit Headshots along with contact info.  

Franklin: Male, age range 27 to 33. Full of life, funny, always has jokes, and sings his heart out. However, he's keeping a secret boyfriend that he thinks no one in the family knows about. Must be comfortable playing a gay role and must be able to sing.

Stanley: Male, age range 25 to 30. Cool, laid-back, friendly guy unlike his sister and mother.  

For submissions: Taraentertainmentllc@gmail.com

Bright Star Touring Theatre is currently seeking actors for our 2-person national tours. We are accepting performers from all backgrounds for shows all year, but our current focus is hiring performers for our Black History season (January-March) featuring shows such as “Heroes of the Underground Railroad”, “The Life of Dr. King” and more!

This is a paid opportunity, including a compensated rehearsal period, with travel and lodging provided for the duration of the contract. There is availability throughout 2027. Compensation is set at $450/week, with a $50/week bonus upon completion of the tour.

Applicants should have professional theatre training and experience (a theatre degree is preferable), a valid driver's license, as well as a clean driving and criminal record. We are currently only accepting applicants who are 21 or older. We are looking for strong character actors who are self motivated, independent, and want to travel to exciting, new places!

Please submit your headshot, resume, and availability to hunter@brightstartheatre.com to be considered. We will be conducting virtual auditions on an ongoing basis.

Applicants should have professional theatre training and experience (a theatre degree is preferable), a valid driver's license, as well as a clean driving and criminal record. We are currently only accepting applicants who are 21 or older. We are looking for strong character actors who are self motivated, independent, and want to travel to exciting, new places!

Please submit your headshot, resume, and availability to hunter@brightstartheatre.com to be considered. We will be conducting virtual auditions on an ongoing basis.

HALLOWEEN SCARE MAZE EXPERIENCE 👻    - 🎃 ACTORS WANTED!
📍 Tintwistle, Derbyshire | 30th & 31st October 2026

⭐ Great opportunity to gain live performance experience & add to your acting CV

We're looking for actors/performers to join us for our Halloween scare maze on Friday 30th and Saturday 31st October, taking place in Tintwistle, Derbyshire.

We've been running our scare experience as a family-run event for around 8 years, and every year we continue to make it bigger and better. What started out much smaller has grown into a production with detailed sets, animatronics, props, lighting, sound, strobe effects, special effects and a large cast of actors.

This year we're looking to build an even bigger cast and are looking for people who would love the chance to get involved in a proper live, immersive performance environment.

🎭 What could you be doing?

• Playing a dedicated character within the attraction

• Performing jump scares and character interactions

• Working within themed rooms and sets

• Improvising and interacting with members of the public

• Working alongside other actors to create scares

• Potentially having a character, room or jump scare specifically designed around you

This is an unpaid opportunity, and a free event with donations going towards North West Air Ambulance Charity. ❤️🚁

However, this could be a great opportunity for actors and performers looking to gain practical live performance experience, build their CV and get experience performing for a live audience in an immersive environment.

You don't need professional acting experience to get involved. We're mainly looking for people who are enthusiastic, confident, creative and willing to throw themselves into a character and have some fun with it!

👻 The earlier you get involved, the more we can create around you!

Once we know who is joining the cast, we can start planning characters, costumes, makeup, rooms and individual scares.

If we know you're coming early enough, we can potentially build a room around your character, design a jump scare specifically for you, create props for your scene and develop your character within the attraction.

So the sooner we can get our cast confirmed, the more time we have to make your part of the experience really good.

📅 Friday 30th October (6-10pm)

📅 Sat 31st October (6-10pm)

📍 Tintwistle, Derbyshire

❤️ In aid of North West Air Ambulance Charity

If you're interested, please comment below or send me a DM with a little bit about yourself, any acting/performance experience you have (if any), and which date(s) you're available for

.

We're hoping to put together a really strong cast and a massive Halloween experience this year, so if this sounds like something you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you! 🎃👻

Feel free to tag any actors/performers who might be interested!

Angela Boehm Casting is now casting Principal Actors for the upcoming Feature Film "The Red Head" filming in the Covington, KY area from November 2nd, 2026 - December 12th, 2026.

Please read carefully below for details!

This project will be taking place in the Covington, Kentucky Area. (Performers must qualify as a local hire to the production location in Kentucky. Production will not provide travel, lodging, or per diem. Please do not submit unless you meet the local-hire requirements. If you are not a Kentucky Local Hire and would like to send in your audition, and slate that you are not local hire and where you are from, then we can put you through in the second round if we do not find local hire.)

DETAILS:
- Project: Feature Film 'The Red Head'
- Filming Location: Covington, KY Area (MUST WORK LOCALLY TO KENTUCKY)
- Shoot Date(s): 11.02.2026 - 12.12.2026 
- Rate: SAG-AFTRA Low-Budget Pay Rate

PLEASE NOTE: This project involves very sensitive topics pertaining to WWII & The Holocaust, and anyone submitting for any roles for this project should have that in mind.

SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS:
In order to submit for this project, you will need to film a self-tape reading from the 'SIDES' attached below! 

THERE IS ALSO A PDF INCLUDED THAT PRODUCTION WOULD LIKE YOU TO READ BEFORE TAPING. THIS HAS THE CHARACTER DESCRIPTIONS & STORYLINE.

Please send your video to team@angelaboehmcasting.com. Please use 'DropBox', 'WeTransfer', etc. DO NOT SEND A YOUTUBE LINK.

Also, please attach a headshot and full-body photo along with your tape!

SUBJECT LINE: "Red Head Submission (Role Name) - YOUR NAME"

Slate Instructions: Please list your Full Name, AGE (ONLY IF MINOR), Location, Phone Number, & if you have an agent! PLEASE PUT SLATE AT THE END OF YOUR TAPE.

Audition Directions:
- Please do not tape outside
- Please have a blank background
- Please put slates at the end of the audition.
- Please keep all videos between 50-100mb!!!
- DEADLINE: Monday, October 12th 2026 @ 10:00am

Link to Sides/PDF: bit.ly/RHFilmSides

Angela Boehm Casting Team
PLEASE NOTE: This is just a submission. If you are booked, we will reach out to YOU.

Szymonek potrzebuje 16 mln złotych na leczenie.
 Na tę samą chorobę zmarł jego wujek
Szymek Kowalczyk przyszedł na świat jako zdrowe dziecko, jednak z czasem jego rozwój zaczął budzić niepokój - chłopiec przestał przybierać na wadze, a kolejne badania tylko potęgowały obawy rodziny. Historia choroby w najbliższym otoczeniu sprawiła, że lekarze zdecydowali się na pogłębioną diagnostykę. Wynik okazał się dramatyczny: u Szymona potwierdzono dystrofię mięśniową Duchenne'a, ciężkie, postępujące schorzenie genetyczne. Chłopiec otrzymał kwalifikację do terapii genowej w Dubaju, która daje nadzieję na zatrzymanie choroby, ale jej koszt przekracza możliwości rodziny. Rusza walka o czas i o życie pięciolatka.
Dystrofia mięśniowa Duchenne'a - historia Szymonka, który walczy o życie.
Jeżeli chcesz pomóc Szymonowi, wesprzyj założoną na rzecz jego leczenia zbiórkę. 
Szymek Kowalczyk urodził się zdrowy. Otrzymał maksymalną liczbę punktów w skali Apgar, a jego rozwój początkowo nie budził żadnych zastrzeżeń. Dopiero po pierwszych urodzinach pojawiły się niepokojące symptomy - osłabienie mięśni, trudności z siadaniem i wstawaniem, a także brak przyrostu masy ciała.
- Okazało się, że jest to dystrofia mięśniowa Duchenne'a. Jak już ta choroba bardziej postępuje, dochodzi do takiego zniekształcenia nóg - opowiada w materiale Dzień Dobry TVN opiekunka prawna chłopca, Agata Kozubaj.
Dystrofia mięśniowa Duchenne'a to jedno z najcięższych schorzeń genetycznych. Choroba prowadzi do stopniowego zaniku mięśni, odbierając dzieciom sprawność, a w późniejszych latach także możliwość samodzielnego oddychania. W rodzinie Szymka ta diagnoza ma szczególnie bolesny wymiar - na tę samą chorobę zmarł jego wujek.
Sytuacja rodzinna Szymonka jest równie poruszająca, co jego historia medyczna. Chłopiec wychowuje się u Agaty Kozubaj, która przez lata pełniła funkcję rodziny zastępczej dla jego mamy. To pani Agata przejęła opiekę nad Szymkiem, gdy okazało się, że chłopiec potrzebuje stabilnego i bezpiecznego domu.
- Mama Szymka jest córką siostry. Jej mama nie była w stanie zająć się i opiekować się nią, i cały czas byliśmy dla niej rodziną zastępczą, i wychowywaliśmy ją do pełnoletności. Poznała partnera, wyprowadziła się od nas z Szymonem. Później dostaliśmy informację, że szukają rodziny zastępczej dla Szymona i zgłosiliśmy się, że chcemy być rodziną zastępczą. (...) My Szymona traktujemy jak naszego wnuczka. Nawet nie przeszło nam przez głowę, że Szymek trafi do kogoś innego - zapewnia opiekunka pięciolatka.
Szansa na życie dla Szymonka - terapia genowa w Dubaju
W przypadku dystrofii mięśniowej Duchenne'a czas jest kluczowy. Im wcześniej rozpocznie się leczenie, tym większa szansa na spowolnienie lub zatrzymanie postępu choroby. Szymon został zakwalifikowany do innowacyjnej terapii genowej w Dubaju.
- Bardzo nas ucieszyła ta informacja, że możemy leczyć Szymona, że jest światełko nadziei. Cały koszt leczenia to 16,5 mln. Jest to bardzo duża kwota, której nie jesteśmy w stanie sami zebrać. Może są dobrzy ludzie, którzy nam w tym pomogą - mówi ze wzruszeniem Agata Kozubaj.
Rodzina chłopca rozpoczęła zbiórkę, licząc na wsparcie ludzi dobrej woli. Każda wpłata przybliża Szymka do terapii, która może uratować jego życie. Bez niej choroba będzie postępować, odbierając mu sprawność, a w końcu - szansę na dorosłość.
- Ta choroba jest taką chorobą, która powoli zabiera władzę w mięśniach. Mięśnie obumierają i chłopcy z tą chorobą w bardzo młodym wieku umierają - uświadamia pani Agata.

The Audition Pal - Giveaway time! 🎭🥳🎉
Something New + Very Exciting! 🤩💛

We want to do something really special for our acting community, as a thank you for being part of the journey and supporting what we do ⭐🙌

We’re giving 1 lucky person the chance to win 3 free places in our future upcoming Casting Director workshops!! 🎉

These are just some of the incredible casting professionals we’ve worked with recently.

We’ve recently hosted workshops with casting professionals whose collective credits include projects for:

Netflix, Prime Video/Amazon, Disney+, BBC, ITV, Channel 4, HBO, Sky, Apple TV+, the History Channel + more! 🎬🔥

How to Enter:

1️⃣ Follow @theauditionpal on instagram 

2️⃣ Like the post

3️⃣ Tag 3 actor friends in the comments (counts as an additional entry)

4️⃣ Share the post to your story and tag us (for a bonus entry!)

This means you could get up to 3 entries! 🎉

Important Details 🚨

* Giveaway closes: October 16th, 23:59

* Winners announced: October 18th, 22:00

* Must be 18+ to enter

* Winners will be contacted via Instagram DM

Good luck everyone 🤍🎭

CASTING CALL: BACKGROUND ACTORS + FEATURED BARTENDER

KIN & CONFLICT FILMS

CLUB SCENE / RESTAURANT SCENE

Kin & Conflict Films is looking for background actors to join us for an upcoming production! We are seeking individuals to bring our club and restaurant scenes to life, including a featured bartender.

ROLES NEEDED

Featured Bartender

- Hispanic or Black male
- Ages 21–35
- Attractive, confident, and camera-ready
- Must be comfortable portraying a bartender on camera
- IMPORTANT: Applicants interested in the featured bartender role must indicate “Featured Bartender” in the Special Notes section of their application.

Club & Restaurant Background Actors

- Men and women welcome
- Ages 21+
- Must be comfortable in a club or restaurant environment

SHOOT DETAILS

- Shoot Date: October 16, 2026
- Location: Austell, Georgia
- Potential Call Time: 6:00 PM
- Estimated Filming Time: Approximately 6 hours
- Availability: Must be available for an overnight shoot
- Compensation: Unpaid
- Perks: IMDb credit and meals provided on set

This is a great opportunity to gain on-set experience, build your IMDb credits, and be part of an independent film production!

TO APPLY

You must apply through our website:

https://kinandconflictfilms.com/pages/open-casting-calls

Questions?

Kinandconflictfilms@gmail.com

FOLLOW KIN & CONFLICT FILMS

Instagram: @kinandconflictfilms
Facebook: Kin & Conflict Films
TikTok: @kinandconflictfilms
YouTube: KinandConflictFilms
Website: Kinandconflictfilms.com

Stories rooted in conflict. Characters rooted in truth.

**PRODUCTION DESIGNER WANTED – SHORT FILM**

Looking for a Production Designer to join our short film **Oh What a Tragedy**, a darkly comic relationship drama shooting in **West Hampstead, North London**.

We’re looking for someone to help dress and shape the living-room set, working with existing props and furniture to create a believable, slightly unkempt home for a couple in their 30s.

**Dates:**
24 October – set dressing / prep
25 October – shoot day

**Location:** West Hampstead, North London

This is an **unpaid role**, so would suit someone looking to build credits, collaborate on a strong short, or gain more on-set experience. Expenses provided.

If interested, please DM with a little about yourself and any examples of previous work.

Kurzfristig Darsteller für Musikvideo gesucht - Berlin, Samstag 10. Oktober 🎬
Unser ursprünglich geplanter Darsteller ist leider erkrankt, deshalb suchen wir kurzfristig einen männlichen Darsteller zwischen ca. 30 und 40 Jahren, jung geblieben, schlank und mit natürlicher Ausstrahlung.

Gedreht wird eine atmosphärische Restaurantszene vor Greenscreen. Schauspielerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – wichtig ist, dass du dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und Lust auf ein kreatives Musikvideoprojekt hast.

📍 Berlin

Unser ursprünglich geplanter Darsteller ist leider erkrankt, deshalb suchen wir kurzfristig einen männlichen Darsteller zwischen ca. 30 und 40 Jahren, jung geblieben, schlank und mit natürlicher Ausstrahlung.

Gedreht wird eine atmosphärische Restaurantszene vor Greenscreen. Schauspielerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – wichtig ist, dass du dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und Lust auf ein kreatives Musikvideoprojekt hast.

📍 Berlin

📅 10. Oktober

🎬 Professioneller Musikvideodreh

🍴 Catering am Set

Bei Interesse schick uns gern kurz ein paar Infos zu dir und ein aktuelles Foto.

Unser letztes Musikvideo:

https://share.google/H3OPj1ohwT91DCpsF

items.text: Je suis diplômé du GITIS à Moscou, recherche un comédien pour une pièce sur Amadeo Modigliani âgé de 23 à 33 ans pour des représentations au Théâtre au centre de Paris. Les répétitions sont en coursselon le système Stanislavski. Une pièce moderne avec quatre personnages. La durée de la représentation est de 50 min. Ce travail est en tant que bénévole, mais nous espérons obtenir un contrat et de l'argent. Répétitions au théâtre le dimanche et 1 à 2 fois en semaine sur rendez-vous à un horaire convenant.

Hello Actors, my name is Jennifer Roberson & I am a talent agent with The Wayne Agency and the agency headquarters are in Los Angeles.  I am sharing this opportunity again and if you have not already submitted for this, I would encourage you to do so quickly. We are in the process of narrowing down our selections for the    in-person auditions. Below is all of the information. 

The Wayne Agency is expanding their roster & is hosting an open call for actors looking for representation in the Atlanta, South Central/Texas, Los Angeles, Virginia/East and New York markets.  Ages 5 and up.  There is no fee with this reputable open call and no fees attached and there will be no costs if signed.  We are a proud SAG-AFTRA franchised agency governed by SAG-AFTRA rules.  For the audition, please prepare a 30-60 second commercial (that you connect with and can show us your “brand”) and also either a scene or a monologue.  If you select a scene, you may perform a scene from tv/film and please keep it between 2-3 pages. **OR** for a monologue, please perform a piece that is no longer than 1-2 minutes.  If we are interested, we will reach out to you to schedule an in-person audition time in the Denver area between October 30th-November 1st.  Please submit the Google form below.  If you do NOT have a GMAIL account, please send everything listed on the Google form to the email address: [twashowcase@gmail.com](mailto:twashowcase@gmail.com).  If you have a question, please ask it here. And please check out our website: [https://www.thewayneagency.com/](https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__www.thewayneagency.com_&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=o8JSr2h6ujNaDfELoLPC65IJVNeuU24Z4w1rP9idmLE&m=FdJWRu-Lu0jmEpoXGZU5JTg6gievjZQr9R7oYXoApBVoIaqJpebQR3JX897EmLzD&s=io2WPYSjpcbjWTnt_Ic1cOeHsmZOO2EV16b429WqH8o&e=)

CASTING CALL FOR SHORT FILM SHOOTING OCTOBER 12TH!!

Title: Kneel

Genre: Horror/Comedy

Logline: A goth girl commands a procession of strangers to kneel before her.

Roles:

Salem (female, 20-30) A mysterious and unnervingly confident woman who doesn't behave like someone walking into danger. She is the danger that has arrived. Must be comfortable wearing dark stylized makeup and wardrobe (black lipstick, dramatic eye makeup, black lace, gothic accessories, black thorn crown, etc) Makeup provided on set. We will source accessories/wardrobe items if needed.

Men (male, 20-30) Several male actors to portray men dressed in suits who emerge from the shadows and kneel before Salem.

Production Type: Indie

Production Company: Loste Films

Contact Information: luke@lostefilms.com

Compensation: Paid

Audition Information: Send an email with headshot, resume and reel. 

Shooting Schedule: October 12th evening/night

Filming Location: Downtown Denver

Project Description: Kneel is a short-form horror/comedy skit being produced as promotional social media content for a local Denver nightclub. This is a fun highly visual project intended to feel like a mini horror film.

CAST & CREW CALL: INDIE HORROR POC (ADDITIONAL SCENES & EDITING)
Project Type: Short Horror / Proof of Concept (POC)

Compensation: In-Kind / Unpaid Passion Project (Meals, stills & footage for reels, IMDb credit, festival entry)

Location: Colorado Springs, CO

Shoot Dates: October 26th, 2026 (Additional dates TBD)

About the Project

We have cut a 10-minute short horror film for the Fresh Meat competition 2027. Now, we are expanding our Proof of Concept (POC) and shooting several additional scenes. We are looking for passionate, creative collaborators to join our Auteure Films production of SuperNova.

Logline: A 23-year-old woman, who suspects she’s losing her mind, attends a support group for young adults diagnosed with a rare illness and finds that they all share a curious history.

CASTING CALL (Additional Roles)

Leo / 25-45/ Male: Tall, big, burly biker type. Looks intimidating but has a heart of gold.

Heather / 25-45 / Female: An aging cheerleader type. Protective, positive, and deeply supportive of others.

SusieQ / 25-45/ Female: A Barbie-like persona. Enthusiastic and sadly sweet, SusieQ brings hope to the group.

Remington ‘Remi’ / 25-45/ Male: Elegantly dressed with a French accent. A sophisticated companion whose goal is to protect and incite joy.

Doctor / 30-45/ Male: Tall, clean-cut professional in scrubs. A supportive friend who is bewildered by the circumstances.

Paramedic Assistant / 25+/ Open Gender: Accompanies the lead paramedic to a crime scene.

Commitment for Cast: Currently one day, evening of Monday, October 26th. Additional shoots tbd.

CREW CALL (Additional)

Camera Operator: Experienced with cinematic framing, dramatic lighting setups, and capturing fluid horror/suspense shots.

Production Sound Mixer / Recordist: Experienced with capturing clean dialogue and building atmospheric tension on set. 

General Production Assistant (PA): General on-set support including assisting the Producer and with craft services, managing props, and assisting talent/crew as needed.

POST-PRODUCTION: HORROR FILM EDITOR

The Role: An experienced video editor who understands the pacing, tension, jump-scares, and rhythm specific to horror and suspense.

The Task: Collaborating with our Directors, DP, and Supervising Editor to piece together past dailies, additional scenes, and music into an integrated, polished 30-to-40-minute POC film.

Requirements: Previous experience editing indie short films or horror projects. Remote flexibility.

How to Apply

Submission Deadline: October 16th, 2026

Please send an email to our Casting Director at auteure.casting@gmail.com with the subject line: 

Role/Position Applied For- [Your Name]

Please include the following in your email:

Your full name, phone number, and the specific role you are applying for.

CAST: Attach your headshot, acting resume, and a link to your reel/monologue.

CREW: Attach your production resume and a link to your website/portfolio (if applicable).

EDITOR: Include your portfolio/reel link, phone number, and your general availability for the month of November.

Note: Cast & Crew applicants must have open availability on October 26th from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM in the Colorado Springs area.

**Szukamy osób do krótkiego nagrania na social media!**

Poszukujemy osób do udziału w rolce promującej kabanosy. Nagranie będzie miało formę krótkiej, swobodnej sondy – do powiedzenia będą dosłownie 1–2 zdania na temat produktu i pokazanie naturalnej, pozytywnej reakcji na jego otrzymanie.

Nie wymagamy doświadczenia przed kamerą, zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności i swobodzie wypowiedzi.

**Wynagrodzenie: 80 zł za ok. 30 minut.**

📍 Miejsce: Wrocław
📅 Termin: 13–15 października, w godzinach 11:00–15:00 (do uzgodnienia)

Przed nagraniem konieczne będzie podpisanie zgody na wykorzystanie wizerunku w materiałach publikowanych w mediach społecznościowych marki.

Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o wiadomość prywatną wraz z aktualnym zdjęciem.

Casting Call for a Short Film (updated with one more lead role)
Hi everyone! We are casting for an independent short film shooting in📍Bucharest, Romania in early November.

Genre: Psychological Drama / Crime Comedy

📃Synopsis:

The film follows two brothers who travel to Romania believing they are about to inherit a fortune from their supposedly dying aunt. A series of misunderstandings and increasingly disastrous decisions turns their inheritance trip into a chaotic night on the run.

🎭 TIM

Gender: male

Playing ages: late 30’s - mid 40’s

Language: English with a UK accent 

Tim is an older brother. Reserved and overwhelmed, he is going through a quiet midlife crisis and feels stuck in life. He works as a supermarket shelf stacker and desperately wants a sense of achievement and recognition.

Tim is more grounded and responsible but his patience is constantly tested by his younger brother’s behaviour. Beneath his frustration is a vulnerable man who loves his brother, is proud of him, and desperately wants a win of his own.

Looking for:

• Excellent English with a UK accent

• Strong screen presence

• Naturalistic acting and strong emotional range

• Ability to play restrained frustration and vulnerability

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

🎭 JOE

Gender: male

Playing ages: 20–30

Language: English with a UK accent 

Flamboyant, confident, funny and highly verbal. Joe is intelligent and successful, but underneath his confidence is an emotionally immature younger brother who desperately wants his older brother’s approval.

He uses humour as a defence mechanism, becoming more sarcastic, energetic and ridiculous when uncomfortable or afraid.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Improvisational instincts

• Strong screen presence

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

• Ability to shift naturally between comedy, arrogance, fear and vulnerability

🎭 AUNTIE VIOLET

Gender: female

Playing ages: 65-75

Language: English with a UK accent 

A key supporting role with relatively short screen time, but an important presence in the film. 

Violet initially appears to be a wealthy, eccentric elderly woman whom the brothers believe is dying. 

She is glamorous, sharp, mischievous and intimidating, with a strong sense of control and authority.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Confident, commanding presence

• Ability to convey glamour and authority

• Ability to play sudden, realistic death

• Comfortable with profanity

Note: The final head-explosion effect will be created using a dummy/prosthetic. The actress will not be in danger.

▪️Audition: Self-tape

▪️Only all expenses related to the project will be covered, including meals, travel.

📩 To apply: send your headshot + CV to cinedanny88@gmail.com

Please include “TIM”, “JOE” or  “AUNTIE VIOLET” in the subject line.

📢 Feel free to share this casting call with anyone you think might be a good fit for either role. Thank you

🎬 **CASTING CALL — ACTOR WANTED**

I'm looking for a **male actor aged 45–60** to play **MARK**, a parole officer, in a short dramatic project titled **“Dean vs Dean.”**

🎭 **THE ROLE — MARK**

Mark is an experienced parole officer with around **20 years in the prison system**.

After years of seeing prisoners released and sometimes return to prison, Mark has become somewhat weathered and disillusioned with the system. However, he still believes strongly that people can change.

He sees genuine progress in Dean and believes he deserves the opportunity to prove himself outside prison.

Mark is experienced, pragmatic and quietly optimistic. He isn't naive about Dean's behaviour, but he believes that **Dean is moving in the right direction**.

🎭 **THE PERFORMANCE**

This is a **subtle, naturalistic role** built around dialogue and subtext.

Mark and Caroline have fundamentally different views about Dean's future. What begins as a professional discussion gradually develops into a restrained disagreement.

There is **no shouting or melodrama**. The tension comes through tone, pauses, looks, understatement and small changes in behaviour.

Mark should feel like someone who has spent 20 years doing this job. He has confidence in his judgement and doesn't feel the need to prove himself.

As Caroline challenges his assessment, his frustration gradually becomes more apparent. Even at the most tense moments, Mark remains controlled and professional.

The role would suit an actor who enjoys **quiet, character-driven performances where what isn't said is just as important as what is said. (Basically anyone who has experience passive workplace arguments) **
🎬 CASTING

**Role:** Mark
**Gender:** Male
**Age:** 45–60
**Experience:** Professional or experienced amateur actors welcome
**Style:** Naturalistic / dramatic / understated

📅 **Shoot date:** December
📍 **Location:** Canada Water, London
💰 **Payment:** Unpaid

If you're interested, please drop a comment or **send me a DM with a headshot and showreel if available**, along with a little information about yourself and your acting experience.

Thanks!

**STAND-IN / EXTRAS / WARSAW / CHILDREN & TEENAGERS**

We're looking for stand-ins / extras aged **1 to 17** for a movie project - no experience required, you will be asked to do very simple tasks like "opening fridge", "sitting on couch" or "turning on TV".

We are looking for kids and teenagers of the following ethnic backgrounds / appearances:
* African
* Hispanic
* Asian
* Indian

**Where:** Warsaw (or Gdańsk).
**When:** One day between October 26th and 30th. The shoot will take approximately 1.5 hours.
**Rate:** PLN 500, paid via BLIK.

If you are interested, please email **[atlanta.int.casting@gmail.com](mailto:atlanta.int.casting@gmail.com)** with the following information:
* full name
* age
* contact phone number
* current photos

You can check our agency here: www.atlantafilms.pl

🎬 **Darsteller/in für Social-Media-Werbedreh in Innsbruck gesucht**

Für mehrere kurze Reels und Werbevideos für ein Unternehmen aus dem Bereich **Photovoltaik** suchen wir eine sympathische Person vor der Kamera.

**Wichtig: Du solltest Tiroler Dialekt sprechen.** 🇦🇹

Was wir suchen:
• Mann, Frau oder divers, erwachsen
• Tiroler Dialekt
• Sicheres und natürliches Sprechen vor der Kamera
• Sympathische, positive Ausstrahlung
• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Reels, Social-Media-Videos oder Werbeaufnahmen
• Texte locker und glaubwürdig direkt in die Kamera sprechen können

📍 **Drehort:** Innsbruck, Tirol
📅 **Zeitraum:** 19.–23. – der Dreh findet an einem Tag in diesem Zeitraum statt
⏱️ **Dauer:** ca. 5–8 Stunden, eventuell kürzer
💰 **Vergütung:** 400 € für den Drehtag

Es geht nicht um klassisches Schauspiel. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass die Videos **natürlich, sympathisch und glaubwürdig** wirken.

Bei Interesse gerne **per PN melden**  oder per Whatsapp +4915114945400 und am besten direkt ein kurzes Video, Reel, Showreel oder einen Link zu bisherigen Aufnahmen mitschicken.

Gerne teilen oder passende Personen markieren. 🙌

অপেক্ষা... শুধু অপেক্ষা!
অপেক্ষা হ্যাঁ, অপেক্ষা নিয়েই তো বসে আছি আমি। কিন্তু কার অপেক্ষা?
না, আমার কোনো প্রেমিকা নেই। তার অপেক্ষায় বসে নেই আমি। আমি তো অবিবাহিত, তাই স্ত্রীর অপেক্ষা করারও প্রশ্ন ওঠে না। তাহলে কার অপেক্ষা?
বন্ধু? দূর! এই বয়সে নতুন করে বন্ধুত্ব করার মানুষই বা কোথায়? যাঁদের বন্ধু বলে জানি, তাঁরা সবাই নিজেদের সংসার নিয়ে ব্যস্ত।
তাহলে?
আমি অপেক্ষা করছি কাজের। একজন শিল্পী হিসেবে নিজের কাজের।

বন্ধু? দূর! এই বয়সে নতুন করে বন্ধুত্ব করার মানুষই বা কোথায়? যাঁদের বন্ধু বলে জানি, তাঁরা সবাই নিজেদের সংসার নিয়ে ব্যস্ত।
তাহলে?
আমি অপেক্ষা করছি কাজের। একজন শিল্পী হিসেবে নিজের কাজের।

items.text:
Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat oraz osoby do poszukiwania takich osób do odgrywania scenek na nagrania w Gdańsku lub w Warszawie.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Termin i godziny do uzgodnienia. Nagrania są od poniedziałku do piątku.

2. Lokalizacja: Warszawa lub Gdańsk.

3. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

4. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

5. Szukamy pilnie również osoby do szukania takich dzieci o etnicznej urodzie. Wynagrodzenie za znalezienie takiego dziecka, które zostanie zaangażowane do projektu — do uzgodnienia. Prosimy o wiadomość na adres e-mail rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Na jakie miasto jest wysyłane zgłoszenie dziecka? Na Gdańsk czy Warszawę? Czy na oba miasta?

8. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Na jakie miasto jest wysyłane zgłoszenie dziecka? Na Gdańsk czy Warszawę? Czy na oba miasta?

8. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

**Casting Call for Student Film "How Human Are You?"**

Hey! We are casting our film practice short film “How Human Are You?”

It is a modern adaptation of the last scenes of Hamlet. We are looking to cast the three main male roles as well as extras. 

There would be one main day of filming during the week of the 9th of November, and rehearsals in the weeks beforehand. 

As this is a student production, this will be unpaid; however, we will cover your travel and food costs during shoots and rehearsals. We would love to have you involved! If you are interested, send me a DM on Instagram at @anamarialtavini or email [amaltavini@gmail.com](mailto:amaltavini@gmail.com) with a headshot, and we’ll send you a section of the script to read through!

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out!

topComments.text:
The majority of UK film schools and unis pay external actors at least the National Minimum Wage and use the Equity student film contract because they recognise this is work and must be paid. Consider pushing back against your uni to help yourself recruit a wider talent pool as well as helping actors get paid the legal minimum. 
Best wishes

ECHO | LONDON OPEN CALL 2026
Group Exhibition
2–5 November 2026
Blank Canvas Gallery, London
Presented by Yune Art
With media support from Harper’s BAZAAR

THEME

ECHO explores what remains after an event, a gesture, a relationship or a generation has passed.

Expectations surrounding family, gender, the body and identity can travel across generations, changing as they move between different people, environments and cultural contexts.

The exhibition considers how emotional residue, cultural memory and inherited experience are transformed through time, migration, material and the body, eventually resurfacing in new and sometimes unexpected forms.

We welcome submissions exploring themes including generational experience, memory, identity, family structures, gender, the body, inheritance, and transformation.

Submissions are particularly encouraged from artists mainly working with glass, textile, sound, sculpture, installation, although other contemporary practices will also be considered.

SELECTED ARTISTS WILL RECEIVE
- Physical exhibition in London
- Media support and exposure through Harper’s BAZAAR
- Opportunities for artwork sales
- Professional exhibition documentation
- International promotional exposure

SUBMISSION DETAILS
Submission Fee: Free
Exhibition Fee: Applicable to selected artists only
Submission Deadline: 26 October 2026
Exhibition Dates: 2–5 November 2026
Venue: Blank Canvas Gallery, London SW6 7EJ

To apply, please submit your portfolio+ artist/work statement to:
yune.art@outlook.com

https://www.instagram.com/yune_art_official?stkn=MTJyODhzYWVvcGhhdA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

With media support from Harper’s BAZAAR

THEME

ECHO explores what remains after an event, a gesture, a relationship or a generation has passed.

Expectations surrounding family, gender, the body and identity can travel across generations, changing as they move between different people, environments and cultural contexts.

The exhibition considers how emotional residue, cultural memory and inherited experience are transformed through time, migration, material and the body, eventually resurfacing in new and sometimes unexpected forms.

We welcome submissions exploring themes including generational experience, memory, identity, family structures, gender, the body, inheritance, and transformation.

Submissions are particularly encouraged from artists mainly working with glass, textile, sound, sculpture, installation, although other contemporary practices will also be considered.

SELECTED ARTISTS WILL RECEIVE
- Physical exhibition in London
- Media support and exposure through Harper’s BAZAAR
- Opportunities for artwork sales
- Professional exhibition documentation
- International promotional exposure

SUBMISSION DETAILS
Submission Fee: Free
Exhibition Fee: Applicable to selected artists only
Submission Deadline: 26 October 2026
Exhibition Dates: 2–5 November 2026
Venue: Blank Canvas Gallery, London SW6 7EJ

To apply, please submit your portfolio+ artist/work statement to:
yune.art@outlook.com

https://www.instagram.com/yune_art_official?stkn=MTJyODhzYWVvcGhhdA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

**PAID CASTING CALL — ADULT ACTORS**

Windstar Studios is casting several roles for an upcoming commercial filming in Colorado Springs.

We are looking for:
* **Two women, approximately 60–70 years old**, to portray friends enjoying coffee together. All demographics welcome.
* **Father and adult son**, with the father approximately 50–60 years old and the son in his mid-20s. Must plausibly portray father and son. Real father-son pairs are encouraged to apply.
* **Two adults**, **approximately 30–40 years old,** to portray the parents of an infant. The baby has already been cast, so we're looking for actors who can believably portray the child's parents.

**Age ranges are flexible for actors who are a good fit for the roles.**

**Production details:**
* **Shoot dates:** October 20–21
* **Pay:** $400–$800 per actor, depending on role and usage, including rights for use in perpetuity
* **Location:** Colorado Springs, CO

Interested actors, please send me a private message or email **[jegraham@adproresults.com](mailto:jegraham@adproresults.com)** with your age, recent photos or headshots, acting experience (if applicable), and availability for October 20–21.

Selected applicants may be asked to submit a short self-tape audition.

**Production company:** Windstar Studios

items.text:
**Crew Call - Los Angeles (San Fernando Valley)** NO/LOW PAY

I'm looking for the last couple crew members for our short film that will be used for a promotional and crowdfunding campaign. The writer/director and cinematographer are AFI alumni with established producers onboard. It will be a weekend 2 day shoot, October 17-18. Locations between Sylmar, Van Nuys and North Hollywood.

About the film:
The film follows a TikTok star suffering from an anxiety attack while stranded inside his trailer during a film shoot, but an unexpected encounter with a production assistant forces him out of his isolation and into a brief connection with the world around him. Our film explores the complexities of anxiety, isolation, and the self-imposed pressures we face in our pursuit of success.

We're currently looking for:
HMU - $300 flat stipend/kit fee
2nd AC - no pay, great for recent graduates
We also need extras on the 18th!

We are covered generally for other positions, but please feel free to send your resume in case of last minute availability changes.

If interested in collaborating, please email  sarahniver@gmail.com with your desired position in the subject line along with your resume or CV and portfolio (if applicable). Thank you so much!

items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

**Tworzymy czułą przestrzeń twórczą, dla Twojego dziecka, na Mokotowie!**

**Mała Akademia Teatralna **Czuła Fundacja Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie wystartowała!

Są jeszcze ostatnie miejsca w obydwu grupach!

Podaruj swojemu dziecku bezpieczną przestrzeń do rozwoju, profesjonalnej edukacji teatralnej i eksploracji wyobraźni!

Spotykamy się we wtorki.

Z dziećmi od 7 do 9 lat - od 16.00 do 17.30.

Z dziećmi od 9 do 12 lat od 17.30 do 19.00.

w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury

Zajęcia Małej Akademii Teatralnej to profesjonalna edukacja teatralna, w poszanowaniu granic uczestników. Na moich zajęciach dzieci się wygłupiają i szaleją. Mogą zrealizować wszystkie swoje pomysły. Twarzą pełne wsparcia relacje rówieśnicze.

Pamiętam, czego mi brakowało, kiedy jako dziecko uczyłam się teatru. I właśnie to - daję teraz dzieciom.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej o naszych warsztatach artystycznych i twórczej działalności, odwiedź naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/tworcze-przestrzenie

albo stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Możesz też do nas napisać na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Zapraszamy na zajęcia w najbliższy wtorek! Dołącz do Drużyny Czułego Teatru!

Warszawa - PILNE
Na ostatni plan serialu historycznego XIX i XX wiek szukamy statystów.

Ostatnie 2 dni 13.10 lub 14.10

13.10 kobiet i mężczyzn jako Patrioci śpiewający piosenki patriotyczne. Osoby mówiące biegle po polsku

14.10 kobiet, mężczyzn i dzieci. Różny wiek i wygląd.

Obowiązkowe przymairki 12.10 na Mokotowie 

Stała łączna 170zl netto
Dzieci 250zl netto
Płatne gotówką

Dzieci tylko z aktualnymi zgodami PIP

Zgłoszenia na maila
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com 

Tytuł data dyspozycyjności

W treści podaj
- aktualne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.
Panowie zdjęcie boku fryzury. Kobiety włosy rozpuszczone i bez makijażu
- imię i nazwisko
- wiek i wzrost
- info o tatuażach i aparatach na zębach
- nr tel

items.text:
Hello! 

We are casting for another tourism video filmed out in Kamloops. We are looking for an adventurous couple, approximately 45–60 years old, who have a natural ease, playfulness and convincing chemistry together. We would love to see a couple that can spark off each other, and are able to tease each other in a light hearted way, without taking themselves seriously. 

We’re looking for people who feel:

* Warm, curious, and naturally engaging

* Ready for adventure and enjoy an active lifestyle

* Curious about travel and the people they meet

* Comfortable hiking recreationally

* Relaxed and natural on camera

* One member of the couple must be comfortable driving with a full drivers license 

* Will need a standard American accent

The short video follows a couple through a series of experiences - hiking, biking, wineries, and restaurants. The idea is to showcase that this region has something to offer for everyone; both the adventure seekers and the chill outers. The couple will be reading reviews of the spots as they go along, and find themselves getting curious about what they might discover. 

Details:
- 3 days w/c 19th October
- Day rate range $700-$1000 depending on experience
- Kamloops area, must be able to drive to location

If interested, please complete below submission and email georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS **

For this project, the client is looking for a couple submission only. 

We would love to see you both in frame, side by side, framed from the top of the head to just above chest. 

Please submit:
* Slate
* Scene 1
* Scene 2

**On your slate we would love to see:**
* Name, height, location, union status

**Scene 1**

Describe your last adventure weekend. Where would you go, what activities would you do? What roles did you both play on the trip? Does one of you do the planning, how do you compromise? 

**Scene 2**

Find an online review for any location, coffee shop, restaurant, and read it allowed to your partner. Discuss between you what you think it’ll be like, and you decide to give it a go!

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL — THE NEIGHBOUR

We are currently casting for our upcoming short film **THE NEIGHBOUR**, a psychological drama about a reclusive woman whose carefully hidden past is disrupted when a young girl from next door discovers her secret.

🎭 **ROLES:**

**GRETCHEN - Female, 60s**
A reclusive woman who has spent decades disappearing from the world. After a troubled childhood and a life built around staying unseen, a young girl begins to break through her walls.

**PIXIE - Any Gender, 10–14**
A sharp, observant kid who acts like she has everything figured out. Behind her tough exterior, she is simply looking for someone to step in and protect her.

**ANNIE - Female, 30s**
Pixie’s mother. Exhausted and overwhelmed by life, Annie keeps going because she feels she has no choice. Beneath her sharp edges, she deeply loves her daughter.

**DERIC - Male, 30s**
Pixie’s father. Volatile and desperate, he is convinced he has been wronged. The role requires an actor who can shift from threatening to shaken within a single scene.

📍 **Shooting Location:** Greater Vancouver Area
🎥 **Shooting Dates:** November 20–22, 2026
📅 **Call Backs:** October 22, 2026
📍 **Call Back Location:** 142 Water Street, VFS Film Production

**Union & Non-Union welcome.**
Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**
Please send your **Resume, Headshot, and Demo Reel (if applicable)** to:

**[theneighbour.production@outlook.com](mailto:theneighbour.production@outlook.com)**

Please include the **role you would like to be considered for**.

🗓️ **Deadline: October 15, 2026**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**.

If you know an actor who would be a great fit, please **share this post or tag them below!** 🎬

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

sharedPost.text:
“WHAT DO YOU NEED THE WORDS FOR?”
«Τι τα θέλεις τα λόγια;»

🎬 My new music video is now live on YouTube.

Filmed at the Barbican Centre, London, the video explores a woman through fragments, memories, reflections and fleeting glimpses. Yiannis Katsaris’ visual approach brings together photography, cinematic shots, multiple images and transitions, creating a photographic collage inspired by La Jetée and David Hockney’s photographic work.

A very special thank you to Yiannis for seeing the song in such a unique way and creating a visual journey from introspection and uncertainty towards light, self-awareness and renewal.

🎵 CREDITS

Music: Giorgos Potamianos
Lyrics: Thanos Sofos
Performed by: Elena Hadjiafxendi
New arrangement & musical approach: Nicos Evangelou
Mix: Mikaela Tsangari
Mastering: Pete Maher

Artistic direction & photography: Yiannis Katsaris — https://www.yianniskatsaris.co.uk
Costume styling: Matina Mavragani
Hair & make-up: Lubna Ashiblie (Lubby)
Assistant Director: Cristina Filimon

A huge thank you to the whole team for bringing this vision to life.

I’d love you to join me, listen to the song and discover the world we created together.

▶️ WATCH THE FULL VIDEO HERE
https://youtu.be/NA6UINC79TI?is=ev2lXbGLSozG_pNi

items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

Feel free to reach out here or via Instagram @zakharin.photography.

items.text: Hi my daughter age 14 has been in acting classes for a few years now and wants to cast, where’s the best place to start or look please?

topComments.text:
You can join sites like Mandy and keep an eye out for open castings for lower budget Indie films etc but be vigilant, do your due diligence and ensure it is properly licensed.
The vast majority of professional work is cast via Spotlight for which she needs an agent. Unfortunately age 14 is pretty much the worst age to try to start and it may be better to wait until after GCSES and things pick up a little, agencies may be more receptive etc... right now unless she is tiny and looks young so could pass for age 11 there are very few opportunities indeed especially without previous experience and agencies already have their books full of teens who have been doing it for years all chasing very few opportunities... It costs at least £300 per year to have Spotlight and Headshots before any other costs... It is also generally very quiet in the industry... My 14 year old has lots of experience but auditions are more and more rare.

It's a really tough age as a teen coupled with it being really quiet at the moment.  Can check out open castings on instagram or sites like Mandy but finding an agent gives best chance.  Needs to be looking as young as possible

We have a SHELL job we are casting for specifically on Thursday, 8th October 2026

Please see roles below:

JHB Asian Mom
JHB Asian Leo
JHB Asian Dad

Please have a close look at role descriptions, JHB Talent will need to self tape but if you have talent in CPT please state this under provisions and we will invite to studio.                                               
JHB Asian Mum
Description
__________________________
30- 40 yrs

Mum is the kind of parent who quietly helps fuel Leos imagination.
She gives him the freedom to explore, create and get lost in his own world, while always being there with warmth, encouragement and a playful spirit.
She has a natural way of making everyday moments feel special and brings a genuine sense of joy and creativity into Leos life.

Mum is a grounding force that brings a sense of warmth and comfort.

In casting, we need to get a sense of how our parents interact with children.
You can spot right away if the performer has that mum or dad energy with how they play, and how they redirect the kids on their own.
Gender
Female
Playing Age
30 to 40 years
Appearance
Asian
Rate
R10,000 day fee
View And Respond To This Role
JHB Asian Dad
Description
__________________________
30-40 yrs

Dad is the kind of parent who turns simple drives with Leo into something they both look forward to, whether it is heading out to a forested road or just around the
neighbourhood.

Their adventures often begin with a stop at a Shell forecourt, and Dad has quietly noticed how much Leo has absorbed from those moments, especially the Click. Shtick. Vroom. ritual he has created from the familiar sounds of filling up.

He has a calm, grounding presence that gives Leo the freedom to let his imagination run wild,
while still being right there with him, ready to tap into the kid in himself and share in the joy of the moment.
Dad shares his love of cars and always supports Leos curiosity and imagination.

Will involve penalty shootouts and will also have a cooking/eating element where you'll share a roast dinner. Shooting in London on the 26th of October. £500 payment for lead coach role and £300 payment per player. Please e-mail erica.stein@ladbiblegroup.com if interested. Thanks!
